title: The Fort in the Yard
lines: Ben and Pam make a fort in the yard.
It starts with a big box and a card.
The fort is dark in the back part.
Pam gets a jar and a short candle.
Ben sets the jar on the sand.
Then a big dog runs in the yard.
He jumps on the fort and it drops.
Pam and Ben are sad for a bit.
Then Ben starts the fort back up.
This time the dog can help.
He naps in the dark part of the fort.

questions.ask: What did Ben and Pam make the fort from?
questions.listenFor: A big box and a card. The jar and candle came after, for the dark part, so listen for the order.
The big dog jumped on it. Right in the text, so send them back to that line if they guess.

questions.ask: Do you think the dog helped or made a mess? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story, like he broke it first, or he ended up napping in it.
